newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber stable in late bearish trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber stable in late bearish trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were stable in late trading amid lack of direction, traders said.

They said a deal was done at 44 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang for September shipment. Offer prices were quoted at 43.50 for August shipment fob Padang, 44.50 for October shipment fob Medan, 44.00 for August shipmnent fob Surabaya and 43.75 for August shipment fob Pontianak and Jambi.

"In the general, the market lacks direction and sentiment is still bearish. We just don't have any idea when the INRO (International Natural Rubber Organisation) will come to the market," said one trader in Padang, West Sumatra.
"We are still in the dark and don't expect much in the market before INRO takes action," said another trader.
The INRO's five-day average price strengthened at 182.27 Malaysian/Singapore cents a kg on July 14, compared to 182.07 on July 11. The daily indicator rose to 183.92 from 182.63 previously.
